content.comment_body: I've been using [product_name] on my PDC for years and experienced a similar issue—the log only collected the first entry, showing the year as 2000, instead of gathering data every 10 seconds as intended. This problem seemed to resolve itself some time ago, but now it's happening again. I'll try deleting and recreating the log block, but clearly something is not right. For context, I'm using [product_name] with maximum configuration blocks and logging nearly all variables. I do have a memory alert program running, but everything else appears functional and I've respected the maximum block limit. Could this be related?

Hello, The memory limit notification you mentioned is just a warning. If you perform an upload, the arrangement may get mixed up and not retain its original order. In my experience, the data log still functions even if layout memory is overwritten. Regarding the first data entry showing the year 2000—it seems the date and time on your [product_name] might not be set correctly. If possible, share your [product_name] program (as a zip file) so we can review it.

analysis.insight_summary: The users describe an ongoing problem where the logging feature only records the initial data entry, rather than logging data at the set intervals. The issue recurs despite utilizing maximum allowed configuration, which raises concerns over memory management and block capacities. There is also mention of unclear memory notifications and possibly incorrect system time configuration, leading to unreliable logs and reduced usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the logging feature to reliably collect all entries at specified intervals without omissions. Additionally, they want memory alerts and notifications to accurately indicate any underlying faults that affect logging performance.
